align_device_and_dtype: align device and dtype of a tensor or dictionary of tensors to specified device and dtype
apply_compile: apply torch.compile to a model with full or regional compilation scope
clip_grad_norm_: clip the gradient norm of model parameters to a maximum norm with pipeline parallel support
enable_determinism: enable deterministic algorithms and set random seeds for reproducibility across distributed ranks
get_submodule_by_name: find a submodule in a model by name with optional wildcard support
